p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-api-types Not Implemented — missing blocked_by field in shared types
p2_findings.detail: UpdateFeatureRequestInput (line 32) and UpdateBugInput (line 59) lack required blocked_by?: string[] field. Causes as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx lines 291/293.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[]; to both interfaces in portal/Shared/api.ts; remove as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed Not Implemented — seed.ts absent
p2_findings.detail: Spec requires idempotent seed script with 7 dependency links wired into startup. No seed.ts exists. Fresh environments start with zero dependency data.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts per spec; wire into portal/Backend/src/index.ts after schema init. Make idempotent.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-frontend-tests Incomplete — DependencySection and BlockedBadge have no tests
p2_findings.detail: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx absent. Only DependencyPicker.test.tsx present. DependencySection (226 lines) and BlockedBadge (70 lines) have zero test coverage.
p2_findings.recommendation: Create both test files per spec with // Verifies: FR-dependency-section and FR-dependency-blocked-badge traceability comments.

p2_findings.title: Portal Routes Call getDb() Directly — service layer not self-contained
p2_findings.detail: Every portal route calls getDb() and passes db to service functions. 14+ call sites in bugs.ts alone. Same pattern in featureRequests.ts. Routes are coupled to DB abstraction; services untestable without stubs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Move getDb() calls inside service functions. Remove db parameters from all service signatures. Routes should call services with no DB awareness.

p2_findings.title: 164 console.log Calls in Orchestrator — unstructured logging violates architecture rule
p2_findings.detail: Orchestrator uses console.log pervasively (164 occurrences). No trace/span IDs, no log levels, no structured fields. Breaks log aggregation in containerised environment.
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce logger abstraction in platform/orchestrator/lib/. Replace all console.log/console.error. Solo-session only — cannot go through team pipeline.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Has False Positives and Blind Spots
p2_findings.detail: Three defects: (1) blind to portal/ — all FR-001-069 implementations invisible; (2) false positives from narrative text matching FR ID regex; (3) cannot target Specifications/ files directly.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ and platform/ to source_dirs. Tighten FR ID regex. Support --file path to Specifications/.

p3_findings.title: Duplicate Frontend Test Files for WorkItemListPage and WorkItemDetailPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Remove root-level copies; retain tests/pages/ as canonical location.

p3_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 Implemented Without Traceability Comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Update header to # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 — gh CLI and Playwright installed in worker container.

p3_findings.title: DebugPortalPage.tsx Has No FR Traceability
p3_findings.recommendation: Identify or create governing FR and add // Verifies: FR-XXX comment.
